Triple Tonic

InspirationRow 2

You get free elixirs at levels 3, 6 and 9: Elixir of Avarice, Elixir of Force and Elixir of Skill.

What it does

Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice. Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force. Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.

When to take it

Pick it when you want free power boosts in the early and mid game. Use each elixir before a fight or an objective.
